InfoP1: In order to inform you about your journey or your child's journey in our TKD Rawdon Academy, we answer why the belts are handed out and why so many.
InfoListA1: Every advancement of belt color is determined by the degree of learning
InfoListA2: To move from one level to another, you need a set number of hours of learning.
InfoListA3: Some students are more gifted than others and we monitor their growth.
InfoListA4: It is also possible to progress faster by taking all the courses.
InfoP2: There are advancement in levels at specific periods of the year:
InfoListB1: November for beginner to yellow/green belts who are present at all classes (3 times a week)
InfoListB2: January for beginner to yellow/green belts who do 2 courses a week
InfoListB3: February for beginner to yellow, green belt and green belt onwards at 3 classes a week, because the number of attendance is higher
InfoListB4: April for young students at base level  yellow/green belt
InfoListB5: May for all students 12 years and over with green belts or higher
InfoListB6: June for black belts and Dan
InfoP3: In addition, we accomodate exams for a later date for athletes who do not have the required number of attendance or are injured or are not available on the given date.
InfoP4: Note the amount of time expected to advance, according to the color of the belt
InfoListC1: From white belt to green belt, 2 to 3 years
InfoListC2: From green to red belt, 2 to 3 years
InfoListC3: From red to Dan (black belt),  1 year, but always depending on the number of classes attended
InfoP5: Progress may vary for each athlete. For example:
InfoListD2: Be part of the competition team
InfoP6: The coursees are taught with the intention of advancing skill and aptitude, signified by belt advancement. Upon each advancement, the student is given a document outlining the goals and skills required for the next level as to prepare the student for their advancement. All instructors and coaches are certified. The supervisor (Grand Master Christian Sourdif) is recognized in Quebec, Canada and Korea.
InfoP7: For 46 years the Grand Master has been developing athletes, whether recreational or high-level competitive. Your child is in good hands, with all certified academy instructors and trainers.
InfoP8: Thank you and best of luck!
InfoP9: secretary of Grand Maître Christian Sourdif Taekwondo Academy.
